claims.statement: Steam Engine preserves AW IMR 18350 700mAh 8.5C as a 700mAh preset with a 8.5C runtime rating.
The AW IMR 18350 700mAh entry is documented with a red wrapper, button top, and a tested sample measuring 18.3 mm × 35.1 mm.

The AW IMR 18350 catalog entry is a branded rewrap or protected branded cell marketed in an IMR/INR/ICR-family lithium-ion context, but the exact cathode chemistry and underlying OEM were not established.
The exact catalog entry AW IMR 18350 has reliable market-introduction evidence dated 2012-09-30 or earlier.
